content: Based on the provided Knowledge, I can tell you about the Prototipo RS Red/Black/Orange shoes. These shoes offer all-day comfort and versatility. They feature additional comfort padding on the tongue, heel, and collar, an anti-microbial lining for moisture and odor control, and a removable contoured cork & EVA foam insole with a perforated footbed. The shoes are inspired by automotive craftsmanship, emphasizing high-quality manufacturing.
